newsitem.title: PERU: Freed Peru minister denies any rebel surrendered.
newsitem.headline: Freed Peru minister denies any rebel surrendered.

text.p: Peru's agriculture minister Rodolfo Munante, a freed hostage, on Friday denied having seen or heard any of the 14 Marxist rebels killed in Tuesday's raid on the Japanese ambassador's residence try to surrender.

"I have not said that at any time and it seems absolutely absurd," Munante told a news conference. He had been quoted by CBS/Telenoticias television as having described seeing a rebel surrender in the room where captive judges were held.
Munante made no direct reference to reports that Peruvian commandos had captured two rebels alive and executed them during Tuesday's dramatic assault that rescued 71 hostages.
He said the judges' room was about 20 yards from where he was held on the other side of the house's upper floor.
The sound of explosions and gunfire meant that it was impossible to hear what was going on, he added.
All 14 rebels in the building, one hostage and two commandos died in the assault.
